channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US officials secured court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn of crypto stolen from Binance, part of a wider effort to freeze the stolen funds.

item.title: Why an approved token still cannot complete a swap
item.description: A SyncSwap swap can fail after approval because allowance, balance, gas or quote conditions still block the separate transaction. Read the receipt and retry safely.

item.title: How do you redeem LP tokens on Fraxswap?
item.description: To redeem LP tokens for underlying assets, choose the matching pool, enter an amount, review both token minimums, and confirm the withdrawal in your wallet.

item.title: Which tokens can I restake on Eigen Layer? ETH, LSTs and more
item.description: Which tokens can I restake on eigen layer? Native ETH, supported LSTs such as stETH and rETH, EIGEN and other tokens qualify only with a live strategy.

item.title: What Price Impact Means When a DEX Swap Moves the Pool
item.description: What is price impact on a DEX swap? It is how far your trade moves the pool price against you, based on trade size and reserves, before you confirm a swap.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court has cleared the US to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, as tracing continues.

item.title: US moves to seize $1.2bn in Binance theft funds
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized action against more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, while efforts to trace and recover funds continue.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US authorities have court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn from Binance’s $6.3bn hack, while efforts to trace and recover the rest continue.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2bn from Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department won court approval to seize or restrain $1.2 billion from the Binance hack, as investigators continue tracing the stolen funds.

item.title: US gets court approval over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US authorities have court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, part of a wider effort to freeze $2.7 billion.

item.title: Griffin raises $20 million for stablecoin and card services
item.description: Griffin raised $20 million in a Series B led by Octagon Partners to add card issuing and stablecoin reserve and cross-border payment services to its UK banking platform.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft crypto
item.description: US authorities say they froze more than $2.7 billion tied to the Binance theft, with court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of it.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a blockchain option for stablecoin settlement, giving participating issuers and acquirers another route to settle payment obligations.

item.title: Payward adds 200 UK and EU stocks to xStocks
item.description: Payward added more than 200 UK and EU shares to xStocks, widening its tokenised stock range while the tokens remain unavailable to investors in the UK.

item.title: Visa adds Monad for stablecoin settlement
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, giving them another way to settle card obligations in stablecoins onchain.

item.title: Bitcoin and ether hit August lows after US midterms
item.description: Bitcoin and ether fell to their lowest prices since August as traders weighed a Democratic-controlled Congress and recent crypto shocks, leaving the market under pressure.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, targeting 25-second blocks
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting its target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 and setting new limits for shielded activity and fees.

item.title: SEC staff clarifies when token voters count as a central party
item.description: SEC staff added answers on Nov. 2 explaining when token voters may count as a group controlling a network, and when broad governance may not.

item.title: FBI links North Korea to $6.3bn Binance theft
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole over $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, naming TraderTraitor as it urges crypto firms to block the stolen funds.

item.title: Chainalysis breach exposed hashes and live tokens across user base
item.description: Chainalysis says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens were exposed, prompting resets as services return under tighter access controls.
